reason: My broker already puts the same amount into index funds every month and I barely look at it, so I don't need an AI pet rebalancing or paying for me. Right now it's demo money, and demo money isn't worth my time.
objection: I'd be handing my actual savings to an AI agent from an app that doesn't even have a broker partner or a price yet, to do something my autopilot already does for free.
would_change_my_mind: If it were live with a licensed broker I recognize, and it showed it saved me real money in fees or taxes compared with my current auto-invest, for a few dollars a month.
